solver_parameters.channel_weights: evanescent TM and TE Fresnel amplitudes at k_parallel=max(k_eff,1e-3), k_eff=1/max(minimum cross-body centroid separation,0.020 um)
solver_parameters.diagnostic_decomposition: partition of translation derivative by rotor panel; not an independently observable Maxwell-stress face force
solver_parameters.diagonal_self_term: equal-area disk: 1/(2*sqrt(pi*A)) times (1-exp(-x))/x, x=kappa*sqrt(A/pi), with static limit 1
solver_parameters.normal_derivatives: analytic finite-panel-regularized scalar kernel derivatives projected onto tangent bases; diagnostics only
solver_parameters.off_diagonal_quadrature: 2x2 Gauss-Legendre bilinear points per panel; 16 weighted point pairs with sqrt(distance^2 + (A_target + A_source)/(32*pi))
solver_parameters.physics_qualification: Two-component tangential surface-current BEM with regularized dyadic cross coupling, scaled cross interactions, and single-layer self operators; an approximate model, not the complete electromagnetic FSC/PMCHWT equations. Use SCUFF-EM for first-principles electromagnetic results.
solver_parameters.symmetry_method: sum of four cyclic Fourier-block traces

solver_parameters.channel_weights: evanescent TM and TE Fresnel amplitudes at k_parallel=max(k_eff,1e-3), k_eff=1/max(minimum cross-body centroid separation,0.020 um)
solver_parameters.diagnostic_decomposition: partition of translation derivative by rotor panel; not an independently observable Maxwell-stress face force
solver_parameters.diagonal_self_term: equal-area disk: 1/(2*sqrt(pi*A)) times (1-exp(-x))/x, x=kappa*sqrt(A/pi), with static limit 1
solver_parameters.normal_derivatives: analytic finite-panel-regularized kernel derivatives; diagnostics only
solver_parameters.off_diagonal_quadrature: 2x2 Gauss-Legendre bilinear points per panel; 16 weighted point pairs with sqrt(distance^2 + (A_target + A_source)/(32*pi))
solver_parameters.physics_qualification: Panel-collocation scalar Yukawa BEM with dielectric-weighted channels; not an exact vector electromagnetic FSC/PMCHWT calculation. Use SCUFF-EM for electromagnetic results.
solver_parameters.symmetry_method: sum of four cyclic Fourier-block traces

solver_parameters.normal_derivatives: analytic finite-panel-regularized scalar kernel derivatives projected onto tangent bases; diagnostics only
solver_parameters.off_diagonal_quadrature: 2x2 Gauss-Legendre bilinear points per panel; 16 weighted point pairs with sqrt(distance^2 + (A_target + A_source)/(32*pi))
solver_parameters.physics_qualification: Two-component tangential surface-current BEM with regularized dyadic cross coupling, scaled cross interactions, and single-layer self operators; an approximate model, not the complete electromagnetic FSC/PMCHWT equations. Use SCUFF-EM for first-principles electromagnetic results.
solver_parameters.symmetry_method: sum of four cyclic Fourier-block traces

solver_parameters.symmetry_method: sum of four cyclic Fourier-block traces

solver_parameters.symmetry_method: sum of four cyclic Fourier-block traces
